pages.text: $(italic)Crafter/Engineer. No combat tradeoffs — average fighter. Power comes from crafting and machine bonuses.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: 0%  |  Equipment HP: Normal$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$(/bold) No penalties; crafted weapons get special bonuses

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Master Craftsman$(/bold) — 15% chance on craft: +1 to a random existing enchant level. Tools get +10% durability.$(br2)$(bold)Efficient Engineering$(/bold) — Machines within 8 blocks: +15% speed. RF generators: +10% output. Furnaces: +25% speed.$(br2)$(bold)Material Expertise$(/bold) — +20% yield when processing ores. +10% chance for bonus byproducts.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Blueprint Memory$(/bold) — -25% XP cost for anvil ops. -20% material repair cost. -15% enchanting levels required.$(br2)$(bold)Innovation$(/bold) — Every 50 unique items crafted: +1% to all crafting bonuses (max +10% at 500 crafts).

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Overcharge$(/bold)$(br)Instantly repair all equipped items by 20% durability. For 30s: tools +25% efficiency, +15% attack damage. 300s cooldown.
